The VZOR-4 combo sight gives you modular mounts and crisp multi-reticles made for real combat. Recover some tactical lights from the field for my boys, and I'll open up the crate of VZOR-4 optics.

a17953cd9929a8f99f10104c description: Privyet, warrior. You young mercenaries look at the PPSh-41 and laugh because it does not have your plastic Western rails and grips. But 71 rounds of 7.62 Tokarev at close range does not care about your modern rails! Still, if you insist on modernizing Comrade Shpagin's masterpiece, I have tactical conversion kits left behind in our depot. Eliminate a few scavengers on the factory floor to show me you respect the weapon, and the modern furniture is yours.
a17953cd9929a8f99f10104c startedMessageT: Respect the weapon first. Then you may ruin it with rails.
a17953cd9929a8f99f10104c successMessageT: Ha! You see? The old girl still bites. Take the kit, dress her up however you like - she will not mind.

48172ee9574eb40f06a4c7c3 description: Privyet, warrior. When the MVD rearmed, the old PP-19 Bizons were supposed to be melted down. Supposed to be. I have a crate of them from a police depot that somebody forgot to close - helical magazine, sixty-four rounds of 9x18, folds up small enough to hide under a coat. But I do not hand a sixty-four round gun to a man who has never fired a Makarov cartridge in anger. Kill scavengers with 9x18, and bring me weapon parts from the field so my boys can keep the old ones running.
48172ee9574eb40f06a4c7c3 startedMessageT: 9x18 only. Makarov, Kedr, Stechkin - the cartridge is the lesson.
48172ee9574eb40f06a4c7c3 successMessageT: Good. You understand the little cartridge now, so you will understand sixty-four of them. The Bizons are on my shelf. Do not tell the MVD.
